target_customer: Enterprise business and analytics teams without coding skills
problem: Analytics work such as data prep, reporting and modeling is slow and depends on scarce technical staff.
product_category: No-code analytics platform, later AI agent workflow automation

founders.name: Erin Tavgac
founders.background_notes: YC page and Built In name her. Background not found in opened sources.

founders.name: Deren Tavgac
founders.background_notes: Named by YC page and Built In as COO.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting many data sources and offering no-code prep, analysis and reporting needs broad connector and workflow engineering, but uses established techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Workflows built inside the platform create some lock in, but analytics automation is a crowded category.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources. The company later moved to AI agents and conversational analytics (VentureBeat, 2024) and remains independent in searches through 2026.

market_need_then: Enterprises wanted analytics access for nontechnical employees; Built In coverage in Oct 2022 framed the product around that need.

brand_strength.rationale: Coverage is funding and product news only. The rename from Cube Analytics removed confusion with the unrelated Cube semantic layer company, but the sources do not state that reason.

pivots.to: AI agent and conversational analytics platform
pivots.why: VentureBeat and SiliconANGLE (Sept 2024) describe AI agents handling orchestration with no-code now secondary; reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Redbird, formerly Cube Analytics, raised a 7.6 million dollar oversubscribed seed in October 2022 led by B Capital and later rebuilt its product around AI agents in 2024. Its CEO said customers grew sevenfold since the seed. No later priced round, exit or distress was confirmed, so its trajectory beyond seed is unknown.
notes: Competitor list left empty: no source dated near the batch named rivals (Built In and BigDataWire did not). One aggregator lists a 15M Series A and another a Jan 2025 seed, both single source and unverified. Founding year conflicts (one source says 2018 as Cube Analytics), so null. Aggregators also conflict on HQ.
